products.notes: Retailer copy of Mosconi/Gladen spec. 6 inputs low level 2-8 Vrms (>10k) or high level 5-20 Vrms (47 ohm) with auto-sense, plus AUX; 8 RCA out, max 8 Vrms, 50 ohm. 48 kHz/24 bit. Delay step 0.02 ms; other retailers state 0-12 ms range and 30-band fully parametric EQ (+/-12 dB, Q 0.5-40) - not on this page, treat as unverified. THD <0.003%. 4 presets. USB + optional MOS-BTM Bluetooth.

Press/retailer data only: 8 in / 12 out at 8 Vrms max (600 ohm). Input sensitivity 1.2-8 Vrms low level / 3-20 Vrms high level. Sample rate conflict: 96 kHz/24 (spec list) vs 192 kHz (PASMAG, Car Toys) - omitted. 31-band 'para-graphic' EQ per PASMAG; delay step 0.02 ms (range unconfirmed). Superseded by AERO 8|12 DSP.
